_metadata.description: Published Pauling electronegativity differences dchi = sqrt(sum c_i (chi_i - chi_bar)^2) (Guo & Liu 2011 Eq. 4), each transcribed from a rendered page of the original PDF on 2026-11-03.
_metadata.use: Regression oracle for tests/test_dchi.py (CALCULATION_AUDIT.md section 3.19). Formulas are the printed ones, read as atomic proportions by hea_calc.core.composition.parse_formula.
_metadata.rounding: Guo & Liu print two decimals and agree with round-to-nearest (|calculated - printed| <= 0.005). Singh et al. print three to five significant decimals and agree with truncation, not rounding: 0 <= calculated - printed < one unit of the last printed digit (e.g. 0.36157 printed 0.361, 0.35656 printed 0.356, 0.23690 printed 0.236).

guo_liu_2011_table2.source: S. Guo, C.T. Liu, Prog. Nat. Sci.: Mater. Int. 21 (2011) 433-446, Table 2 'Calculated parameters dHmix, delta, dchi, dSmix and VEC for alloys used in Figs. 1 and 2', p. 437 (PDF page 5, read on a 220-dpi rendering), column dchi.
guo_liu_2011_table2.scope: Every row of p. 437 with an unambiguous formula (41 rows). Excluded: '6FeNiCoSiCrAlTi' (printed formula does not define the amounts unambiguously) and the continuation on p. 438, whose PDF text layer has lost the row alignment of formulas and values.

Zr50Ni50.reason: Equiatomic binary: dchi = |chi_Zr - chi_Ni| / 2 = |1.33 - 1.91| / 2 = 0.29 exactly, from the paper's own Table 1. The printed 0.24 cannot be reproduced with any reading of Eq. 4 and Table 1; recorded as a misprint, the reference value is not changed.

singh_2023.source: S. Singh, N.K. Katiyar, S. Goel, S.N. Joshi, Sci. Rep. 13 (2023) 4811, Table 2 (p. 12) and Table 3 (p. 13), column dchi, read on 200-dpi renderings. The paper computes dchi 'following Guo et al.' (its ref. 35 = Guo & Liu 2011).
singh_2023.note: Not model M4 (Singh, Kumar, Dwivedi, Subramaniam 2014). Table 3 heads the composition 'wt %', but its values and descriptors only reproduce as atomic fractions.
